html:
Ripper McGee's Ripper McTee... Rex (External Use Only!)
Damage Type:  Slashing Damage
Wielding:  Two-Handed
Attack Speed:  Fast
Requires:  Level 98


"This is a shout out to Ripper McGee! Thanks for going above and beyond, and over and through, and under and past, and... well you get the idea. Twitch indeed!"

Two-handed mythic (rainbow) melee weapon. Soulbound in 10 minutes.

Attributes:

The name and the look are fixed. The joke ending is one of the weapon suffixes. That ending is what sets the primaries.

The rest of the stats roll and do not show up in the name.

  • Steal: health steal, mana steal, or both. Random.
  • Speed: movement speed, melee attack speed, or both. Random.
  • Resists: a random pair or triple from divine, fire, ice, poison, and shadow.
  • Crit: crit chance or crit damage. Random.

It is unknown how many different varieties exist. The same ending can still drop with different rolls underneath.

Sample at level 98 (stats scale with item level):

  • Slashing Damage: 241 to 1688
  • +217 Agility
  • +4% Health Steal
  • +4% Mana Steal
  • +13% Melee Attack Speed
  • +214% Melee Critical Hit Chance
  • +139 Shadow Damage Resistance
  • +139 Divine Damage Resistance

NOTES

Developer shout-out weapon. Not in the original Townstons dump — added from an in-game tooltip.
